name: Liuzhou

queries.query: 柳州市 不动产登记 地籍图 查询 GIS 公开地图 柳州市自然资源和规划局
queries.scope: Find the local registration institution and an anonymous parcel-vector service.
queries.result: The 2025 Liuzhou Natural Resources and Planning Bureau budget identifies the city Real Estate Registration Center and cadastral-rights review work. A local city housing/transaction site provides contract-query functions, including captcha fields, but no anonymous full parcel geometry viewer was found. The bureau also published a large-scale land-spatial planning information platform; available evidence describes agency systems, not public parcel downloads.
queries.executionMethod: Separate Chinese-language search and municipal bureau/transaction-site inspection; no personal record query and no captcha or login used.
